named_premises: If grace/external coupling is absent, the system's coherence after the transition is not greater than before (closed-system second-law analog: C_after <= C_before).
A sign-flip from sigma = -1 to sigma = +1 is a coherence increase: C_after > C_before.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Any moral sign-flip from -1 to +1 requires external grace coupling, because a closed moral system's coherence cannot increase and sign-flip is a coherence increase.

obstructions.reason: A nonpreserving operation is not by itself an actual external restorer, still less God/Grace; causal exhaustiveness, occurrence and identification require their own premises.

The derivation stops at the step from 'creaturely moral goodness is dependent participation in God' (A0 + P-IMAGO) to 'a closed moral system cannot increase its own coherence and requires an external grace function G(t)'; that step needs additional moral, thermodynamic, and model premises not admitted.
